title: The Algorithms — Python
summary: A large, readable collection of algorithm implementations in Python.
description: Hundreds of implementations for sorting, graphs, dynamic programming, data structures, and more, each with tests and explanations. Useful for comparing approaches and preparing for interviews.

title: Project Based Learning
summary: A curated list of tutorials that teach by building real applications.
description: The Python section links to guided builds for web apps, scrapers, games, bots, and data tools. Pick a project slightly beyond your current level and finish it rather than collecting tutorials.

title: Python Programming Exercises
summary: A graded set of Python exercises with solutions, from basics to intermediate problems.
description: The exercises are organized by difficulty and cover strings, loops, data structures, functions, and algorithms. Solutions are included, so the value comes from attempting each problem before reading them.

title: Python Projects
summary: A growing collection of small, buildable Python project ideas and code.
description: A companion project space for the learn-python repository, focused on approachable builds that reinforce the language. Use it when you want a concrete next project rather than another tutorial.

title: Pythonlings (TUI Exercises)
summary: A Rustlings-style set of small Python exercises that teach by fixing failing tests.
description: Short, focused exercises introduce a concept and then ask you to make the tests pass. The feedback loop is quick, and the repository is small enough for beginners to read end to end.

title: 60 Python Projects with Source Code
summary: Coder's Camp documentation and guides for practical Python development.
description: 60 Python Projects with Source Code is an article from Coder's Camp, filed under Top Blogs in the learn-python directory. Articles mix explanations with runnable examples and next steps. It suits beginner developers and is free to use.
